no_bundled_stub_or_demo_modules.instructions: Is the project structure free of in-process stub/fixture/demo-world backend modules bundled inside production source directories?

criteria.pass: Production source directories contain only real application modules and external API clients; any mock servers, fixtures, or seed worlds live strictly outside production runtime directories (such as in dedicated test/e2e/external mock tooling).
criteria.fail: Production source directories (such as `app/lib/` or `src/server/`) bundle in-process fake backends, stub stores, demo-world seed files, or demo-overlay modules imported by production routes. Naming or commenting them as temporary demo aids does not turn a fail into a pass.

no_parallel_shadow_directories.instructions: Is the project structure free of parallel shadow feature directories (such as `phase1/` or `legacy/` mirror folders) and parity test suites policing duplicated variants?

criteria.pass: Each feature lives once in its directory without cloned version-mirror subdirectories (`phase1/`, `v1/`, `legacy/`) and without dedicated parity test files whose purpose is keeping duplicated UI variants or fake-world stubs in sync.
criteria.fail: Features contain cloned parallel mirror subdirectories (such as `phase1/` folders duplicating parent screens/columns/filters/hooks) or dedicated parity/demo-overlay/stub-smoke test files policing self-inflicted duplication or fake-world internals.
